For a 2008 Honda CR-V (RE3), the following DENSO wiper blades fit:  
- DCP-026R/L +SIDE CLIP (driver) and DCP-017R/L +SIDE CLIP (passenger)  
- DCS-G026 +SIDE CLIP (driver) and DCS-G017 +SIDE CLIP (passenger)  
- DCV-026 +SIDE CLIP (driver) and DCV-017 +SIDE CLIP (passenger)  
- DCS-G024 (driver) and DCS-G017 (passenger)  
- DCS-G024 (driver) and DCS-G018 (passenger)  
- DCV-024 (driver) and DCV-017 (passenger)  
- DCV-024 (driver) and DCV-018 (passenger)  

Note: Rows [2], [5], and [6] all apply to the 2008 CR-V. Row [2] explicitly includes RE3 (and RE4) engines and covers 2006–2011, so it is valid for the 2008 RE3 model. Rows [5] and [6] are for 2008 CR-V generally (without engine specification) but are still applicable as they fall within the model/year range. All listed part numbers are compatible.
